dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: You think so, too? Then you should come to Puspa Café more often. It has people fighting tooth and nail every day!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: I mean fighting in Genius Invokation TCG, of course. If someone started an actual fight, the acting manager would flip out before I did.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Say, are you free now? I want to show you the new deck I built, and maybe you can help me figure out how I can win with it?
